name: Washora
summary: An online portal where customers book clothes washing and pickup from a phone or laptop, choose their services, and follow each order until the clothes are back with them.
metaDescription: SoftCloud Wash is an online portal for booking clothes washing and pickup. Schedule a meeting with Asauvia's sales team for pricing and details.
highlights: Customers book a pickup and delivery slot online
Services and prices set out clearly for each type of garment
Order status updates from pickup to return
An admin view for staff to manage bookings and routes
idealFor: Laundry and dry-cleaning businesses that want to take bookings online

name: Curato
summary: A commerce platform for running a multi-vendor online store in India. Vendors, resellers, cash-on-delivery and online orders, courier shipping and payouts sit in one system.
metaDescription: Curato is a multi-vendor commerce platform with cash on delivery, reseller links, Delhivery shipping and payouts. Book a meeting for pricing.
highlights: Checkout with cash on delivery or online payment through PayU or Cashfree
Vendor onboarding, product listings, orders and payouts
Reseller storefronts with markup pricing and tracked referral links
Delhivery shipping, courier labels and parcel tracking
Operator controls for commissions, banners, settings and support tickets
idealFor: Operators running a store with several vendors or a reseller programme

name: Custom Project
summary: Have a product in mind? We scope it with your team, design and build it, and support it after launch.
metaDescription: Have a product idea? Asauvia scopes, designs and builds custom products for your team. Schedule a meeting for pricing and details.
highlights: Scoped with your team before any build starts
Web, mobile or AI-powered, depending on the problem
Support after launch, agreed up front
idealFor: Teams with a product idea that off-the-shelf software does not cover
